description: Knowledge lifecycle shapes (Epic 9, planning pass 2026-08-06, D1-D5 ruled). Provisional knowledge lives in the per-user store only (AD-3): the per-project spine at ~/.tk-studio/projects/<key>/knowledge/spine.md (D2) and per-run seeds as seed.md in run workspaces. lib/knowledge.py is the one validator (pure - no fs, no I/O); no other surface parses these shapes. Only promoted knowledge crosses to the project VCS, as ordinary kb/ files through a PR - review is the gate (D3, AD-12). Aid, not gate: a red or absent spine/seed never blocks a run.

artifact_frontmatter.note: spine.md / seed.md are markdown with flat YAML frontmatter; the body defines anchors as bracketed ids. Two tiers share the schema.

tier.note: spine: broad, once per project; seed: narrow, per run, inherits the spine

status.note: supersede header, verbatim - provisional knowledge is never canonical

authority.note: supersede header, verbatim (ported wire value, unchanged across drivers): authoritative in-flight, structurally incapable of becoming canonical by accident

run_id.note: the owning run; also the anchor-id middle

spine_ref.note: store-relative path to the project spine this seed inherits from

inherits.note: spine anchor ids this seed reuses verbatim; deltas may cite them

anchors.note: anchor ids are the join (immutable, append-only, never renumbered): SPINE-A<n> on the spine, SEED-<run-id>-A<n> on seeds. Deltas cite identity, not location, so corrections survive every edit. At least one anchor per artifact; duplicates reject; tier prefix must match the artifact tier (seeds may also cite inherited SPINE- ids).
anchors.citations: the bare-id form (no brackets) is what citations carry: handoff deltas (anchor field) and research findings (optional anchor field, ST-9.3 — validated at record time against the run seed's available set, defined + inherited; dangling citations are named rejections). Artifacts land through research.py seed|spine only: the seed verb enforces run identity (run_id, spine_ref, SEED-<run-id>- anchor middles) and verifies inherits against the spine when one exists (missing spine reported, never a gate); both verbs enforce append-only anchors on re-emission.

delta.note: the closed correction shape. Deltas ride handoff.json as structured objects (deltas[] - session surface, shipped ST-9.2, validated against the run workspace's seed.md); unanchored and dangling deltas are named rejections, never silently dropped. Budget ruling (ST-9.2): the 16 KB handoff budget does not grow - deltas share it and the list is capped at 16 per handoff (lib/session.py MAX_HANDOFF_DELTAS).

anchor.note: an anchor id in the seed's available set (defined + inherited)

reality.note: what is actually true, compactly - deltas are pointers, not essays (handoff budget)

evidence.note: where reality was observed, e.g. path:line or a URL

tier.note: run-local corrects the seed; spine flags a project-spine assumption (source vocabulary mg-local renamed run-local in the port)

queue_line.note: one JSON object per line in the per-project reconciliation queue ~/.tk-studio/projects/<key>/knowledge/reconciliation-queue.jsonl (shipped ST-9.4; per-user store only, never project VCS). Dedupe key: (run_id, anchor, verdict, reality, tier) - captured_at and evidence deliberately outside it (re-observing the same correction later or elsewhere is the same correction); tier deliberately inside it (tier names which artifact the correction targets - escalating a run-local correction to spine tier is a distinct routing event, not a duplicate). reality/evidence are single-line pointers: control and line-separator characters refuse at validation (the queue is line-oriented JSONL; the routing doc renders these strings). Capture (lib/reconcile.py) rides two idempotent hooks: each delta-carrying boundary handoff (a later boundary overwrites handoff.json, so corrections go durable at the boundary) and the executing wrapper's every terminal transition (finish/cancel/core close). The queue is append-only - a bad line is reported, never dropped or repaired; duplicate identical deltas within one handoff refuse at the session surface (same anchor+verdict+reality+tier - one correction, stated once).

run_id.note: the run whose handoff carried the delta

grades.note: evidence grades on knowledge stay the studio's shipped A/B/C/D vocabulary (D1 ruling; contracts since 1.2.0 - see lib/research.py). Grade markers in artifact bodies are documentation, not validated shape. Source-vocabulary mapping for readers of first-driver artifacts:

routing.note: the routing doc renders beside the queue as reconciliation-routing.md (shipped ST-9.4; reconcile.py route) - a pure render (knowledge.render_routing) of the queue that APPLIES NOTHING (D3: only a human writes canonical). Deduped on the queue key; spine-tier corrections lead (they challenge the project spine every future seed inherits), run-local follow; WRONG before STALE before CONFIRMED inside each tier; invalid queue lines surface in their own section, never silently dropped. An absent or empty queue answers rendered=false - an answer, not an error.

promotion.note: promotion is drafted from the rendered routing doc into ordinary kb/ files on a branch; PR review is the human gate (D3) - nothing auto-applies, only a human writes canonical (shipped ST-9.5: lib/promote.py draft, the tk-studio-knowledge skill's promote-draft verb; a promotion attempt without a routing doc is a named rejection). kb frontmatter gains nothing; scope: stays reserved and unread (AD-8). Each draft is ONE NEW dated kb file - append-only: a draft never edits or deletes existing kb content. Corrections group one entry per (anchor, verdict, reality, tier) - the delta_key; run provenance merges rather than duplicating - and a correction once drafted never re-drafts (the promotions record below is the baseline; the redraft flag overrides). Emits one knowledge-promotion taxonomy event per batch of newly-merged drafts (at the promotion skill's cadence, one per merged promotion PR), sole emitter the promotion skill (D4) - the taxonomy row and emission landed together at contract 1.7.0 (ST-9.6, lib/promote.py emit; the row had to come first or together: lib/ledger.py refuses un-rowed event types by construction). Merge detection is local git only - a recorded draft whose kb file exists on its base branch has crossed the membrane; the promotions record is the exactly-once baseline: an emitted marker line covers each merged draft file, a covered file never emits again, and the reconcile itself is serialized (a sidecar lock + re-read) so concurrent emits never double-emit.

record_line.note: one JSON object per line in the per-project promotions record ~/.tk-studio/projects/<key>/knowledge/promotions.jsonl (per-user store only, never project VCS; append-only, locked appends, \n-only reads). `type` discriminates line kinds: type=draft (ST-9.5) and type=emitted (ST-9.6); unknown types read forward-compatibly, never as invalid.

branch.note: knowledge/<user>-<machine> - the stable membrane branch; a repeat draft updates it and its open PR

file.note: project-relative kb path the draft landed as (kb/reconciliation-<date>.md, serial-suffixed on collision)

keys.note: the drafted corrections' identity keys (delta_key - run provenance excluded: a later run re-observing a drafted correction is the same correction, not a new promotion)

base.note: the branch the PR merged into

files.note: the draft files this marker covers - the exactly-once baseline: a covered file never emits again

corrections.note: distinct correction identities (delta_key) across the covered drafts - mirrors the emitted event payload
